name: git_facts
author: OpenAgents
description: Report the git state of this repository: current branch, recent commits and history, and which files changed, are untracked, or are missing. It reads .git plumbing files directly — HEAD, refs/heads, packed-refs, the reflog, and a version-2 index — never a git binary, the object store, or packfiles. Its honest limits: history is reflog-based (only as far back as .git/logs/HEAD reaches), changed files are size-and-mtime candidates rather than content-hashed verdicts, index versions above 2 report counts but not per-entry facts, and there is no blame. Anything skipped or degraded is named in notes.

facts.description: Which facts to report. All four when omitted.

max_log.description: Most reflog entries to return. Default 15, capped at 100.

max_paths.description: Most paths listed per status category. Default 20, capped at 100.

max_walk.description: Most workdir files statted by the status walk. Default 5000, capped at 20000.

detached.description: The commit id HEAD holds directly, when detached.

log.description: Recent history from the HEAD reflog, newest first.

changed_candidates.description: Tracked files whose size or mtime differs from the index. Candidates, not verdicts: content was never hashed.

notes.description: Everything honestly skipped or degraded, named.
